item.title: Self-Hosted Service Mesh Sidecar Proxies: Envoy vs Linkerd2-proxy vs NGINX Data Plane
item.description: Service meshes separate network concerns from application code by injecting a sidecar proxy alongside each service instance. This proxy handles service discovery, load balancing, TLS termination, observability, and traffic control — all without modifying your application. But under the hood, these capabilities depend on the sidecar proxy itself.
